findings.detail: C01 counts unfunded commitment rows as debt rows requiring interest_rate even when the raw schedule leaves the rate columns blank and separately identifies the same balances as revolving-loan unfunded commitments.

rationale: The source schedule's investment total ties to the filing total, and representative residual rows are not missed visible coupons: the raw investment table shows Arcfield debt lines with maturity, par, amortized cost, and fair value but blank reference-rate and interest-rate cells. The same balances appear in the commitment table as 1st Lien Senior Secured Revolving Loan unfunded commitments with negative fair value. The extracted missing rate therefore follows the raw source; the aggregate 80% rate-coverage threshold is overbroad for these commitment/blank-rate debt rows.
